name: Necromantic Rituals — 2 Intermediate — Peek Past the Shroud

system.description: Enchant a handful of ergot to transform it into three doses of fine black powder. One dose consumed grants the benefits of Shroudsight (Basic Ash Path Necromancy) for three hours. Critically failing the casting (failing the Mental Challenge and a retest) renders the ergot lethally poisonous, inflicting four levels of lethal damage on anyone who ingests it.
